critic_risk_flags: Although H aligns semantically with hospitalization rate, adding an explicit H compartment (SEIHR) increases complexity and raises identifiability risk in a short single-season series; surveillance note explicitly flags H as potentially weakly identifiable here. Also, mapping weekly admissions to an H stock-like compartment can be a mismatch unless H is clearly defined as incident admissions.

I+H observation map risks semantic mismatch for a hospitalization-rate target (admissions) and can blur distinct processes (infection prevalence vs hospitalization burden). It also inherits H identifiability concerns from SEIHR and may over-flexibly fit level/width without clear justification in this short series.
